definitions.explanation: The designated day on which garbage, recyclables, or other waste is collected by the municipal service. An essential part of daily life in Japan, where garbage sorting and collection schedules are strictly followed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{燃|も}えるゴミ→燃えるゴミ：17105_moerugomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収集日|しゅうしゅうび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧だ。
examples.english: Burnable garbage collection day is Tuesday.

examples.japanese: {収集日|しゅうしゅうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the collection day before putting out your garbage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収集日|しゅうしゅうび}⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦もらっていない→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I just moved and haven't received the local garbage collection calendar yet.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧ (collection) + {日|び} (day). Almost exclusively used for garbage and recycling pickup schedules.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収集日|しゅうしゅうび}: garbage collection day
- {収集日|しゅうしゅうび}⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧: collection day calendar
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収集日|しゅうしゅうび}: next collection day

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, each type of waste has its own designated collection day:
- ⟦{燃|も}えるゴミ→燃えるゴミ：17105_moerugomi⟧: burnable garbage
- ⟦{燃|も}えないゴミ→燃えないゴミ：23525_moenaigomi⟧: non-burnable garbage
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧: recyclables
- ⟦{粗大|そだい}ゴミ→粗大ゴミ：08045_sodaigomi⟧: oversized garbage

Putting out garbage on the wrong day is considered a serious breach of neighborhood etiquette. New residents typically receive a {収集日|しゅうしゅうび}⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧ from the local ward or city office.
